Name: Gabby R.
Review: This was one of the best meals I had while in Amsterdam. It's a very cute Australian cafe in an awesome location (I'm from New York and it very much reminded me of Brooklyn). They had a great menu and we had a big spread with eggs, toasts and more. As other reviews have mentioned we did have to wait a bit to be seated so I would recommend arriving on the earlier side and be prepared for this. I will definitely return here next time I am in Amsterdam.

Name: John T.
Review: Delicious breakfast! Loved the kiwi brekkie, if you don't know what to get, that's the choice for you! Perfect combo, creamy eggs, crunchy salty bacon, meaty sausage, crisp potatoes, creamy mushrooms along with avocado! Get here early to avoid the brunch rush!

Name: Sophia D.
Review: I enjoyed this place so much and it was seriously one of the cutest brunch places I have ever been too. Tucked away in a little street but easy to find. The wait was fairly quick so that was a plus. Also it's located by the Heineken factory so great place to eat at before you go there.I ordered the power shake and the kiwi breakie to share with the boyfriend. The power shake was so good. You would never know it had protein in it besides the peanut butter and I'm not a huge fan of peanut butter but it didn't taste too peanut butter for me and loved the banana. As for the breakfast it was too good and perfect to share with one other person as I don't really eat breakfast or eat too much. I loved the bacon, potatoes and everything else it came with. The egg was poached nicely and the spinach it cane with was good too. This place is a must in Amsterdam to try! Also great for Instagram too

Name: Gerard Y.
Review: I ordered Eggs Royale and a side of Chorizo. The chorizo tasted great and went well with the perfectly toasted sandwich with and egg on each with lovely smoked salmonPlenty of dining choices for breakfast in the area, but I'm glad I chose this place. This is probably the 1st restaurant in Amsterdam where I received great customer service from the wait staff. They checked on me from time to time.

Name: Abby G.
Review: Absolutely amazing!!!!! My roommates and I waited about an hour for a table but it was worth it! I ordered the pumpkin porridge (which I think is seasonal), it came with house made marshmallows and is probably the best oatmeal I've ever had! We also ordered mimosas and for €8, the champagne bottle and orange juice made about 3 of them! The customer service was also amazing, our server was super nice and very attentive! If you're ever in Amsterdam this is a must try!!!!

Name: Erica B.
Review: Such a cool spot.  We grabbed a spot on the first floor on the cute couches rather than wait for a table.  We had some breakfast nachos and gluten-free pancakes.  Both really great.  My friend me I ordered 2 different green healthy drinks. Both were amazing.  This place is fun and the food and drinks are great!

Name: Reza A.
Review: My wife and I found this restaurant as we were desperately looking for a brunch place after sightseeing. We looked through Yelp and nothing really stood out until we found Bakers & Roasters.If you're and Amsterdam native and are looking for an American style brunch experience then this is the perfect location. The menu options, quality of food, and ambience are great. And judging from how crowded it was we can reliably say that others in Amsterdam share the same sentiment.If your a tourist and planning to grab a bite in between activities then we can highly recommend it as well. There are tons of menu options so you'll surely find something you'll enjoy (although the vegan options are somewhat limited). The service is fast Ana's very friendly. The food comes out pretty quickly even though it was packen when we were there and it was laid back enough to relax and catch a breather.I really enjoyed my food (and I'm a brunch snob). My wife was less enthusiastic because of the limited vegan options. Coffee was really great for both of us.

Name: Arthur G.
Review: Insanely legit brunch spot with an awesome menu of items that'll leave you satisfied in every sense of the word. Found this spot on Yelp, looking for a great place to have brunch and was also pleasantly surprised to see that they also served matcha green tea here. Awesome!Ambience is lively and casual, tucked away in a smaller street just off Leidseplein. Highly recommended!

Name: Kelsey M.
Review: WOW! Bakers & Roasters brunch is top notch! Their coffee and espresso drinks are wonderful and their breakfast dishes are delicious and filling. The fresh squeezed orange juice was also a treat. What we tried and enjoyed - a mocha, a flat white, the veggie brekkie, and the B&R special. Other pros - Friendly service and frequent water top offs. A+ experience!

Name: Kristina R.
Review: I love coming here for brunch. It's a must try. Book a table in advance would be very helpful if you don't want to wait for one. The food is always fresh and super delicious. Super friendly staff. Highly recommend it.

Name: Luke S.
Review: Excellent breakfast food place! Went three times while visiting Amsterdam and everything was superb. Loved their pancakes, sandwiches, and deserts. Large portions and every tastes great. The service is a little slow as they are crazy busy all the time. Highly recommended!

Name: Juliana T.
Review: Amazing pancakes and crispy bacon! Very delicious breakfast, highly recommend paying them a visit if you're a tourist or local in Amsterdam.

Name: Laura T.
Review: Super cute brunch spot, service was awesome, and food was bomb. The menu options and flavors were different from what I could get in the US. Must try when in Amsterdam!

Name: Sylvia B.
Review: Love this place. Great for brunch! It gets busy but they will text you when your table is ready, which is really convenient. Highly recommend the navajo eggs, which come with perfectly poached eggs. They make a mean cortado as well!

Name: Helen X.
Review: Love this place!!Excellent service plus wonderful food!!Ordered Acai bowl&Gluten free toast,which is amazing!!!

Name: Allie A.
Review: First of all- order the espresso martini. It's my favorite drink I had in Amsterdam. We had to wait a few minutes for a seat but the text system made it so easy. Food was great, service was great- it looks like you can't go wrong with any of the coffee or food. I would definitely recommend it to my friends coming to Amsterdam. And when I am back in town I look forward to coming again.

Name: Elkhyn R.
Review: We visited B&R on a Wednesday morning (around 9AM). Although the restaurant was pretty crowded, we were seated immediately. If you're looking for a delicious and hearty breakfast (and you aren't in too much of a rush), this is the place for you!Three of us ordered the B&R Special (two eggs, buttered toast, bacon, and three miniature pancakes), while a fourth got the blueberry pancake stack. Given our experience, there are no wrong choices here! The toast was good, the bacon crispy, eggs were light and flavorful, and the pancakes (and maple syrup) fluffy and exquisite.

Name: Brian R.
Review: This is a hugely popular place that has a bit of a wait but was totally worth it! The food is delicious and plated perfectly. I didn't have the pancakes but they looked spectacular. My stack of House hash browns and poached eggs with salmon was tasty and creative! Look at the way my son's sandwich showed up (see photo). Old school paper/string wrap. Very cool. They had a nice DIY mimosa too. Fresh OJ all the way and your own mini-split of bubbly!The staff was great. If you're looking for breakfast, brunch, or lunch you can't go wrong.

Name: Ling S.
Review: Great brunch restaurant. I love the New Zealand Kiwi menu items. Their kiwi mascot has a bowtie, super cute!! It was pretty busy for a Wednesday morning. The restaurant is bright with lots of natural lighting. Every Instagrammers dream, lol. Staff is very attentive and quick to bring out food and drinks. Lots of choices on the menu from standard eggs & bacon, fancy pancakes, acai bowls, sandwiches, cakes, and more. Vegetarian friendly too. I got the Kiwi Brekkie (I miss NZ!). Homemade tomato relish, perfectly cooked eggs, and big pieces of toast. The fiancé got eggs royale. Very generous portion of smoked salmon. We also ordered a short stack of pancakes. They drowned it in too much syrup, but otherwise pancakes are fluffy and very good. Prices aren't cheap, but overall for the atmosphere, service, and food quality; we had a good experience. Would recommend! Next time I will have to save room for dessert. They had so many muffins and cakes on display..!

Name: Teresa R.
Review: Great food and service! American pancakes with bananas were great.  The avocado and and fries cheese were great and the mushrooms underneath were equally delicious. The smoked salmon was served on a nest of shredded hash browns yummo

Name: Kaili T.
Review: BEST. PANCAKES. EVER. This note worthy spot is located close to the Heineken factory, tucked on a cute little tree lined street. (Parking available out front, otherwise close walking distance from the metro)A memorable breakfast in Amsterdam, we waited a short time for a large group and were not disappointed ! The staff was extremely friendly and efficient - great music, bright and stylish decor and the FOOD!!! Oh goodness every last morsel was fantastic! Two in our group ordered the B&R that came with a side of their "American style pancakes" ...and let me tell you as an American they blow our pancakes out of the water ! Other note worthy items include; the huevos rancheros, the kiwi brekkie (an absolute savory breakfast and so surprisingly good!!) and of course the B&R! Just do yourself a favor and scope their instagram. I don't know that words could do them justice ! Absolutely recommend !

Name: Alexa L.
Review: A bright spot on a dreary November day in Amsterdam! This place oozes millennial hotspot--very instagram-esque vibes all around. It was super crowded here but we didn't have to wait too long and were squeezed in. Such a fun laidback atmosphere! The kiwi brekkie did not disappoint at all. The mushrooms on that dish were divine. I ordered the banana nut bread French toast and you definitely need to have a sweet tooth. Lucky for me, I do. So these were right up my alley. Super decadent, very filling, YUM. Great service, awesome food. What's not to like!?

Name: Sylvester C.
Review: Fantastic. It is very busy so be prepared. I was seated pretty quickly though. You should really poached eggs if you come to this place. French toast I had was very very good. The restaurant is pretty large. Servers were nice.

Name: Kate V.
Review: Couldn't be happier with my experience here! I've been in Europe for a couple days and this is the best breakfast I've had in awhile. The staff was very attentive and lovely, the atmosphere was inviting and not too loud. The food was perfection. Can't wait to come back!

Name: Maria F.
Review: The meal was amazing! The service was lovely with a positive atmosphere and good music. There is also vegan and gluten free options.

Name: Cece N.
Review: This place was exceptional! The food was phenomenal and our server was so nice and cordial. We had been to London then headed to Amsterdam when we found this little place with little appeal from the outside but packed with people to get in. From the Cappuccino to my Canadian maple syrup, everything was delicious!! My friends and I would totally recommend you try this restaurant before leaving Amsterdam!!

Name: Megan O.
Review: It has been YEARS since I've gotten to indulge in the amazing ribs at Cafe de Klos, and after finally making my grand return--I'm happy to report they're just as good as ever!They had a "lady" portion, which is 2 slabs instead of the "normal" portion that comes with 3. It was the perfect portion for just myself (and I still had a bit left over for yummy left-overs for my flight home). It comes with a small salad (really tasty) and two sauces; one white, garlicky and savory, and another "pink" sauce that I couldn't quite put my finger on what exactly it was, but it was slightly sweet and delicious all the same. I was originally thinking of getting the smoked ribs, but the server gave me the heads up that those are drier and saltier than most expect--so I took his advice and went with the original. They were perfect. I'm still drooling thinking about them again. Seating is first come, first served, and they are currently not offering any indoor dining--only the outdoor tables, or seating at the bar across the street. Note that space is limited and they do not take reservations. I was lucky enough to get there shortly after they opened for an early dinner (a little after 17:00 on a Sunday in late July) and was seated immediately at an open outdoor table. By the time I was finishing up, close to 18:00, there was about an 30-45 minute wait. So definitely plan ahead and get here early!Can not say enough about this place. The ribs are the true star, but the staff and cold draft Amstels were fantastic as well.Dank u wel Cafe de Klos! I hope it's not another 7 years until I see you again!

Name: Jason G.
Review: I really liked the ribs.  Great smoky and salty flavor with meaty ribs grilled right there.  It's worth a special visit for the food here.

Name: Jacques I.
Review: What may be the best BBQ in Amsterdam! We came here based off its awesome Yelp reviews and the first time we visited the place was packed.  The wait was an hour or so, so we decided to come back on a different day, closer to when they open.  So glad we did, too, because it would've been sad to have missed these spare ribs during our visit to Amsterdam! Specifically, Cafe De Klos is known for its BBQ ribs.  After speaking with our server about the difference between the spare ribs and the smoked spare ribs, he mentioned that the spare ribs have a dry rub versus a hickory, smoky sauce on the smoked ones.  Personally, I'm a dry-rub fan and don't like my ribs sauced up, so stuck with the spare ribs, which I loved.  The spare ribs plate came with a side salad, which was a coleslaw, with two different kind of aioli sauces that you can use for your ribs.  Of the two sauces I preferred the white one, for its garlic flavor versus the tomato-based aioli.  Coleslaw was a good accompaniment for the ribs, adding a nice acidity with its pickled flavor.  And most importantly, the spare ribs were fall-off-the-bone, just how I like 'em!  The ribs were juicy, moist and had an awesome spiced rub on the skin.  The portion was large, but I happily ate all three racks of ribs.  There is a smaller portion option with two racks of ribs for you, amateurs. Cafe De Klos is definitely worth visiting in Amsterdam.  Expect a wait; BUT, its sister bar, Café t Genootschap der Geneugten is across the street, where you can grab drinks 'til an employee from Cafe De Klos will come get you once a table is available.  It's worth the wait.  Space is small inside, which is also why it takes a bit to get a table.  Most of the seating is around the bar.  If you do use your credit card there is a 5% additional charge; bring euros.  Spare ribs for the win here!

Name: Elle S.
Review: This restaurant was recommended to me but even so it exceeded my expectations. The restaurant has maintained the same menu for 48. If people love it, keep it. Two of us ordered the regular ribs and a potato to share, and a basket of bread and butter. The butter is the typical Amsterdam's salted herb butter- amazing. The regular ribs from what I hear are the best, and I can't imagine any being better. This is MORE than enough for two. Portions are huge. We sat at the bar and the bartender was very personable and provided excellent and f service.

Name: Mekenna B.
Review: I'm from the US and this is some of the best bbq I've ever had! It was so good we went twice.

Name: Mehmet A.
Review: Authentic food, one of the best ribs in the city. Worth the wait for sure!

Name: Michael P.
Review: This was the first meal my girlfriend and I ate when we arrived in Amsterdam. Absolutely delicious! This is actual BBQ (surprising I know!) We both had the mixed ribs (smoked spare ribs & spare ribs), both were great but the regular spare ribs were fall off the bone juicy! The meals came with bread and a traditional Dutch salad. These are closer to being American sized portions rather than European. We sat and shot the shit and talked about music and traveling with the bartenders/servers for over two hours. They had the normal beers (Amstel, Heineken, etc) but you have to try De Blonde Barbier and De Manke Monnik (ones a blonde and ones a tripel, but both delicious). Definitely make this a stop if your in Amsterdam

Name: Tim V.
Review: I was very skeptical about BBQ in Amsterdam; however, I have faith in my people...The spare ribs were the equivalent to nearly two racks of ribs in the states and rivaled almost any ribs I have ever had - almost. An amazing dry rub unlike any flavor I've had before. The staff was amazing, witty and obviously possessed Dutch sarcasm.

Name: Hadiza A.
Review: Decor: olde Amsterdam Public houseService: Grace under pressureFood: MOIST MEAT!Lies: Not a café in the least. Zero takeout except foil, and not for children, be advised.Some ales, some wine; house wines red and white crisp, flavourful and recommended. Meat succulent and flavourful. 'Cole slaw' referred to as 'salad' is just this side of not pickled and excellent. Sauces provided with heart attack meats, I attest, full of flavour, desirable, terrible, lovely. Service; witty, expedient, gracious. Felt genuinely Amsterdam.

Name: Jim A.
Review: They are not kidding about having the best ribs. This place has been doing it for 40 years and they have it down perfect. We had the combo plain and smoked rib platter. Nothing left but cleaned bones.Washed it down with a wheat and a trippel

Name: Mike C.
Review: All you folks looking for a dive bar with Amazing Food and Belgian Beers, the place IS IT!!!The decor is Dutch classic and they've easily had the best 80s/90s music playing since I walked in (Nirvana, The Cult, Michael Jackson...). Order the Ribs. The cook honestly carried the last rack to me with tongs from off THE PIT!

Name: Zach H.
Review: A carnivore's dream!  What a great place.  There was a wait, however playing chess and drinking beers at the bar across the street made that go fast.  The spare ribs were excellent and the sides just made it all better.  The staff is fun and happy to joke around.  The service was great.  I can not wait to go back next time.

Name: Lulu G.
Review: This place is a must! You may have to wait and if you do he will seat you at his bar across the street. He will then come and get you when a table becomes available. I had the lady rib which was the perfect portion for me. I didn't have the salad but that's just me, I can't eat too much or drink at the same time. Visiting from the U.S. you are use to quick service. But that is not the case in Amsterdam. Be patient, they did see you and will come to you.

Name: Steven C.
Review: Wasn't expecting Amsterdam to have such good BBQ, but here we are! This place was so good that we ended up coming back again for our last night in Amsterdam! This place has been around 48 years and has a small-ish 1 page menu. There's a reason why- they've perfected everything on it, and you really can't go wrong with anything. They don't take reservations, and the head manager, a sassy thinnish Dutch guy, will tell you as much. They know their food is in high demand, so at this place it's a buyer's market. The "customer is always right" act won't fly here. Be prepared to wait a long time for larger parties during 6-10PM. The best:-The Escargot: Just do it. They even take them out of their shells for you. Dip them in that addictive garlic butter, and then take the bread and ALSO dip that in the garlic butter-The Spare Ribs: The meat falls off the bone, is the perfect level of moist, and the flavor is amazeballs. Make sure to get these. They don't need to be dipped in everything-The bread: They bring you as much as you want, and you can see the freshly-baked baguettes chilling there. I was addicted to dipping this in the garlic sauce they bring with the meatThe great:-The Lamb: Great flavor, not too chewy. You will clean the bone on these. This was the favorite of the bartender that served us the first night, but I liked the spare ribs much betterThe good: Smoked Ribs- These were really tasty, but TBH I've had better smoked ribs in the States. They don't particularly have the "goddamn!" blend of spices and flavors that I've had from other places.Here's what I'd order if I came back:1x Escargot2x Spare Ribs1x Large Amstel. You can't go wrong with anything here though, promise! If you're in the Centruum, make the trip.

Name: Gordon V.
Review: Talk about your mighty meat platter! Be sure to get here early and with a great appetite!If you get here an hour after the place opens, expect to wait a while before you are seated, however they do recommend you to go across the street and grab a beverage.Food was excellent, and very plentiful. Don't need to add any sauces and the meat is very tender and tasty. The potato was great, and a never ending supply of fresh bread. Beer was cold, so if you plan on eating here, get here as early as you can when the place first opens!

Name: Jenni K.
Review: This place is delicious AND hilarious! Be prepared to wait for a table. We went for a drink across the street and the host came and got us. Didn't wait too long and had a rousing debate about the presence of deadly spiders in Holland  with the bartender (spoilers: there aren't any). We ended up being sat at a table even though there were only 2 of us. Shared a mixed rib platter and it was incredible! I'm from North Carolina and these ribs were some of the best I've had bar none. Also soft, delicious bread and fresh coleslaw to die for. Now for the fun part. I watched 3 sets of high bros be turned away from the restaurant because they were rude to the host. This is not a restaurant where that business will fly. Be courteous to the staff and be prepared for a leisurely and delicious meal. Highly recommend

Name: Vasiliy M.
Review: I heard a lot about the ribs in Amsterdam and how I had to try them. Having lived in the southern US for most of my life, I know a thing about juicy hickory smoked ribs. I was excited to try these out and see how they stacked up. First off, busy place. I had to wait for a spot in the corner of the bar, but didn't have to wait too long. The first thing I noticed was the energy here! The waiters and workers were cracking jokes and were very active. Love it!When it came to the food tho (and the cost), my experience did not need the standard set by rib cooks in hicktown, North Carolina. The ribs were soft, but lacked the juiciness and the flavor that I'm used to. And in the end the ribs cost me close to 40 USDs. I could get the same amount for a fourth of that price in the South US :/

Name: Evan K.
Review: I wandered from the North of Amsterdam, around canals, took a ferry, walked over 2 miles sightseeing along the way, to find this gem. When I arrived, as expected, I was told to sit across the street and have a beer while they found me a table. The gentleman was very polite and encouraging that it wouldn't take very long as I was a solo diner that night. He was right. No sooner had I ordered my beer across the street, a fantastic Tripel beer that they allowed me to take across the street to begin my feast. I ordered the regular Spareribs and not the smoked, an order of fancy (or so I thought due to my hunger and misreading) Garlic bread but it was just butter/garlic spread and bread, and another beer while I was there. I was lucky enough to sit at the bar top so the service was fantastic and I was seated next to a nice guy from Uzbekistan (interesting convo..but where here for the food)The ribs were delicious, moist, fall off the bone and seasoned to perfection, not slathered with barbecue sauce etc.. YUM! I had one order and ate it all however if you come with two you could get a great taste and perhaps something else as the rest of the menu looked amazing as well. They also offered a baked potato however it was not necessary for me, and there was an extra charge too

Name: Denis K.
Review: Place is renowned for its meat plates. It offers ribs, steaks, chicken and lamb. Portions are enormous. Food tastes great. Kitchen is visible through a glass windows and one can see it being prepared. There's a nice wooden  u-shapes bar which serves as a dining area. Full bar is available. There are in-house beers available as the place is a microbrewery too.

Name: John T.
Review: Man o man - goooood ribs !I'm a certified BBQ judge in the US & I'm here to tell you the ribs are incredible! The slaw was fantastic as well. (I'm not really a big slaw eater, but it was SO Good, I ate it all). While waiting you must visit their pub across the street as well - great drinks- Highly recommend...

Name: Parker M.
Review: We came here for dinner while in Amsterdam. Be warned: they don't take reservations, and wait times can be lengthy (we waited nearly an hour). That said, this place without a doubt has the best (dry) ribs I've ever had (and I personally prefer dry rubs). Not to be outdone, the garlic butter is also the best butter (of any sort) I've ever come across.On top of that, this place might have the best service I've ever encountered--quick, attentive, and honest. When I mentioned my interest in getting a dessert, I was told without hesitation that the desserts would pale in comparison to the entree and that I'd be better off going round the corner to a pastry shop.

Name: Sydney H.
Review: Amsterdam... oh how many memories were made (and forgotten :x) but the ribs I devoured during my vacation here will ever shine as one of the highlights of this trip. We hear all this talk about texas vs st louis vs carolina style ribs, but holland? let alone Europe? as a contender in the bbq war? Guys believe me these ribs are legendarySetting: dark, intimate, and sounds of conversation really was a pretty cool spot. They operated the restaurant how they wanted to and it felt liberating to dine there. Service: Our server was a really cool guy and knew a lot about meat to make your face blush... Food: The fall off the bone with 0 effort. Literally you pick it up, the meat falls down, and the crowd goes wild! I've been use to the kind of meat where you have to shake it a little bit for the meat to fall off but this was nothing. I prefer dry rub over sauce on my ribs simply because sauce is overwhelming and covers up a lot of that natural taste of the meat. The rub they used was so spot on with the right amount of salty and spice. Overall: I really wanted to come back here before we left, but we just didn't have enough time. If you guys go to Amsterdam you MUST go here, no questions asked.

Name: Enkrypt L.
Review: Best ribs my wife and I have ever had. Ever. I don't even like ribs that much, she loves them, but we were both just blown away. The lady's portion or whatever they call it is a real thing, don't be afraid to opt for it if you aren't feeling ravenous. Sides are absolutely unnecessary. Our bartender was also awesome and hilarious, and he had great recommendations for what else to do in the city, including a neighboring coffeeshop for the necessary supplies if you need to work up an appetite to finish your leftovers. Oh and almost the best part, if there's a wait, you just cross the street to the pub that has the same owner and drink a beer or two before your seats are ready. And unlike Café De Klos, the bar actually has a great beer selection too.

Name: Alec T.
Review: Who would think that Amsterdam would have such a great place for ribs!! This place is really busy--we had to wait about 1 1/2 hours for our table but they have an agreement with a bar across the street where you can wait comfortably until they come over to get you for your table. Servers Kim and Coen were just awesome and made the whole dining experience even better. Personable, friendly and attentive and we ordered ribs, lamb chops, the baked potatoes were freakingly delicious!! The Pate and Cheese Platters were great appetizers.The vibe was great and definitely a place I recommend if you travel to Amsterdam! Free WiFi too!

Name: Andrea S.
Review: We came as a groups and we couldn't even talk during dinner, so delicious bit was. The smokey ribs are the best. Great beer as well.

Name: Kevin D.
Review: Absolutely delicious!  I'm not even a fan of ribs, but I love this place.This is my second time visiting Cafe de Klos.  First time was a few years ago.  It's just as good still!  We showed up around 6-7 PM and our wait was under an hour.  I liked passing the time in the sister bar and didn't even finish my beer before we were called to the table.Get the regular ribs, not the smoked ones.  The smoked ones are a bit dry (or they were a few years ago).  Both of us were really hungry and we made the mistake of getting two portions of ribs.  I really think one should serve two people, even two very hungry people, just fine.  You can always get a side if you think you'll need it.

Name: Misty M.
Review: Cafe De Klos, you literally rock! What else can I say. I was recommended to go here when I was in Amsterdam and figured why not. The recommender said that these would be the best ribs I ever had....well they were right. The ribs were juicy and fresh. We got there without a reservation, but no worries, there is an awesome bar across the street with the same owner. We had a drink across the street there while we waited. The bartender was actually from NYC, which was cool. When our table was ready, the person we left our name with came over and personally apologized for the wait and walked us over to be seated. He didn't even have to apologize, we hardly waited!We ordered the ribs and then an order of the lady ribs, which is a smaller portion. The two together were perfect. Everything was on point, including the amazing baked potatoes you get, which has the BEST topping of butter/garlic on them.Delicious, keep doing what you're doing and please open a location in NYC so I can go!

Name: Elizabeth B.
Review: We have stopped here every visit to Amsterdam. The Mac and Cheese was very good: the addition of Dutch cheeses makes this American comfort food explode with flavor. The Camembert with bread was also amazing, as was the bitterballen. I also tried the pickle back shot which was whiskey with a pickle juice chaser. I loved it (but I also love pickles).

Name: Mehmet A.
Review: The juiciest ribs in town, and even late at night. Multiple locations and very easy to get to. Everything on the menu is pleasing and the prices are fair. It's worth the detour and great service.

Name: Chantel H.
Review: We arrived late in Amsterdam and we were starving! My family picked this spot and when I heard "Cannibale" I assumed nothing available for me to eat but I'll go along. Much to my surprise, they did have a select few vegetarian options on the menu! It is a bar so it was very busy and loud, not in a bad way. Our server was awesome, very attentive and helpful. We arrived past their normal hours of the menu so they only offer about half for the late night bites. (In Europe we noticed many bars/restaurants stop serving food very early, beware of that when looking on Yelp! We were led to many spots with no food options past 10pm.) I ordered the nachos and they were some of the best nachos I have ever had! Nachos are a very simple thing to make but I have had my fair share of bad nachos. The Heineken (when in Amsterdam) was delicious, we were feeling good off a pitcher. My brother kept going on and on about how good his ribs were.

Name: Melissa N.
Review: What a cool vibe in Amsterdam.We were sat near the doors at a 2 top table and it was a pretty loud bar/night scene even on a random weekday.We got the ribs, bitter ballen, corn, and jerk chicken and somehow finished everything. I was surprised at myself for being able to put away the entire rack, the bitterballen and a piece of corn - I really should stop eating so much...lolWe got there around midnight and it was great that they were still serving food until like 2AM because many places stopped serving food much earlier.We had a really cool waitress as well. The staff was chill and we were able to take our time and still get a nice meal.I'd come back!

Name: Devynn H.
Review: My friend and I were visiting from the US and our bartender at the bar we were having cocktails at recommended we come here for some late night eats, specifically the ribs.Upon arriving we were absolutely starving; needed food immediately! After ordering the nachos as a starter, ribs, garlic broccoli and sweet potato fries, I was distracted from my hunger by the fantastic vibe in this restaurant. The servers were having a good time and the music was loud.Our nachos arrived and I was in heaven, I'm not sure if it was my hunger giving wrong signals to my brain, but these nachos were delicious and had an ample amount of cheese. In fact, a neighboring table stopped their conversation to watch my first cheese pull. The only regret I have is that I didn't catch it on video.Here's when things get a little rocky...our ribs took FOREVER. I mean, we got past our hungry and we were falling asleep at the table, our server didn't return to see if we wanted any more drinks or water while we were waiting, and that's the only negative thing I have to say. When our ribs finally arrived, they were absolutely amazing! Tender and fall off the bone, the bbq sauce was perfectly sweet and spicy, I only wish I hadn't eaten so many nachos. The sides were also scrumptious, the garlic broccoli was roasted (my favorite way to eat broccoli) and the fries were crispy and salty.Overall, a great dinner, will definitely return if I ever make it back to Amsterdam!

Name: Alan W.
Review: What a great experience and so much so we went twice in four days.  We stopped knowing we had no reservations and it could be an issue.  They stated they were booked so we sat at the bar and before we could order they had moved people around to get us a seat.  The service was outstanding from the beginning. We ordered a couple drinks before dinner and decided on a few sides and the ribs.  Wasn't sure what to expect of the ribs but honestly I could have eaten several slabs.  They were perfectly tender and had a unique sauce that was a bit sweet.  They were heavily caramelized which placed them in the top five best ribs I have ever had.  Everything was so great we decided to have a late night slab the following night after our early dinner.  Definitely a place to check out but be sure to make reservations as it was crazy busy both nights.

Name: Sara P.
Review: This place was great. We tried the nachos, which are the best nachos I've ever had, and the steak tartar which also was amazing!!

Name: Stella T.
Review: We walked in on a whim, no reservations. The place was jam packed! The friendly hostess was very accommodating in getting us seated fairly quickly. We ordered drinks which came out quick & really spot on perfectly made. The menu is in correlation with the namesake, lots of meat offerings. I ordered the classic burger & the bf ordered ribs. My burger was a tad salty but really good but his ribs! Oooooh man! Those were some serious finger licking ribs! We really enjoyed ourselves here & I highly recommend checking this place out. It's only fair that I pass on the baton since I found this gem through yelp.

Name: Andy K.
Review: Make a reservationI stopped in and was able to get a table with a small wait on a recent visit. I'm so glad I did as this was the best meal I had on my business trip! They have a great beer selection and everything on the menu sounds amazing. We started with the bread, because, who can skip buttered bread?! I had the classic cheeseburger and it was so filling that I couldn't finish the last few bites. The fries were done perfectly and had dipping sauce. I also got a side of broccoli and it was cooked nicely with great flavor. No negatives here. If you're looking for a dinner spot, this is the place.

Name: TD C.
Review: Awesome food! Awesome service! I recommend making a reservation - as it's not a very large restaurant (this the original location - there are newer locations) Our reservation was for 6:15pm and there were not many patrons at that time but by the time we walked out it was full! My daughter and wife shared the ribs and the meat just fell off the bone. I had the Classic burger well done - delicious as well. We also ordered sides to share - Mac and cheese-  super hot and very cheesy; fries - nice and crispy on the outside soft on the inside and the sweet corn which my wife enjoyed. Next time in Amsterdam we will definitely go back!

Name: Valerie C.
Review: This was the first dinner of my friend's Amsterdam bachelorette. My co-planner easily made reservations for a group of 10 in this hot spot right near the Red Light District.Our server was easily one of the best servers I've encountered for such a big group! Our entrees took a little while to come out - but we were happily indulging in bitterballens (omg, BOMB!) and their cheap beers. The entree portions were HUGE and delish! I had the steak tartare and some of of the girls had ribs and their famous burgers. Everything was divine - down to the sides! Such a great first night dinner - thanks Cannibale!

Name: Roxanne G.
Review: Amsterdam is definitely not known for its food, but if you're looking for a delicious meal, then Cannibale Royale is your spot! Cannibale Royale is for meat lovers who enjoy exotic beers and unique wines. If you're coming in around dinner time, try to make a reservation in advance because this place fills up quickly. They also offer dinner at the bar, but if you want a proper seat, then a resi is a must. Everything we ate was amazing - here's what we ordered: steak tartare, lamb chops, bitterballen, a salad with mozzarella, and sweet grilled corn. We were just 2 people and this was plenty of food! We paired this food with the delicious Spanish Red Wine; it like a hybrid between Pinot Noir and Merlot. The steak tartare was extremely fresh. It came with a small quail egg, truffle-mayonnaise, bacon toast, capers, and anchovies. We mixed everything in except for the anchovies. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. The lamb chops were flame grilled frenched baby lamp chops with salsa verde; they were very tender and cut like butter. The bitterballen was one of the best I tried in all of Amsterdam. Bitterballen  are deep fried meatballs; they aren't regular meatballs, they're a mix of meat, flour, and spices. The salad was fresh and flavorful and nice green to compliment the meat. The grilled corn is covered in a vanilla based butter. The flavor was unique but also very delicious - definitely a must try! The staff here was also very friendly and kind. :)

Name: Jenn B.
Review: It was early morning 1:00 ish.  We had just arrived from the airport and the restaurant we wanted to got was closed.  What a fortunate experience.  When we first arrived I was a bit perplexed as no one greeted us and we had to search out someone to seat us.  However, after that the service was amazing! There is a great vibe and the food is terrific.  I believe I ate the best hamburger ever!  We would definitely return!

Name: Rosalind C.
Review: Outstanding service goes a long way and this place has it. We were visiting from the states and arrived with no reservations. The place was packed and the host had a cancelled reservation and sat us. Our waiter did a great job checking on us. We ordered the burger, which was outstanding and the ribs which were ok. Overall a good place to try while in Amsterdam.

Name: Kevin Z.
Review: This is one of the staples people recommend when you come to Amsterdam. They have serval locations and are open later. I can describe the environment as a bar that serves good food. We originally were going to have lunch on our first day, but our Uber driver talked us into another place. However after the café one night we popped in to fix our hunger. When we walked in it was Saturday night around 11pm so they had Kayne blaring. After reviewing the menu we ordered:Le Burger du Moment - it was a burger w/ pork bellyFlame Grilled Lamb T-bonesThe burger was ok. Nothing as exciting as we had heard. Especially since I just had an amazing burger elsewhere this burger had a lot to compare to. Figured that pork belly would edge it out for the win, but not this round. My gf barely ate the lamb as it was a lot of fat. I will say that the bonus is that they do have their own beer that is a blonde, called Cannibale Royale of course!I see why people like this place. It's kitchen is open late. So whether you're coming in after the club, the café or just for lunch/dinner you'll be able to get a bite.

Name: Mike A.
Review: Short version: get the wings, ribs, a burger, garlic broccoli, and a couple Two Chefs beers.  Baller AF.Longer: wings aren't really hot-spicy, but really crispy and flavorful.Ribs are super tender but not mush. Great bark and flavor.Burger... vaporized.And some how we managed to eat a bowl of garlic broccoli with that meat fest because it was perfectly cooked and seasoned. The house beer and Two Chef labeled beer paired great.So full, and so worth it.

Name: Leena R.
Review: I am absolutely in love with this place. I was in Amsterdam for a short trip and looking for a place with a relaxed atmosphere and great drinks where I could get a delicious birthday meal at midnight. Not exactly an easy find as most kitchens in the area closed down at 10pm except for a select few burger/fries spots, but our hotel concierge recommended Cannibale Royale. The ambiance is a nice mix between a restaurant and bar, with trendy decor and super friendly staff. The food is mouth-watering good, which is not an easy thing to find at midnight! I was able to get a huge ribeye steak and a side of some of the best Mac and cheese I've ever had. The beer selection is also pretty great. But the cherry on top of a great meal/drinks/service was when my boyfriend mentioned it was my birthday and our waiter brought out complimentary shots to take with us. We left in such good spirits that we came back the very next day with friends, who also loved it as much as we did. This was the perfect place to spend my birthday and I'll be back the next time I'm in Amsterdam!

Name: Sommer G.
Review: @cannibaleroyale is life changing! From the wings to the cheeseburger to the ribs everything was mind blowing!! I was so so full but I just kept eating! The ribs were some of the best iVe ever had!! I can't wait to go back to Amsterdam just for these ribs!!

Name: alvir n.
Review: Dead babies + top 50 hip hop. Classy.Vegan burger was delicious. Nachos were delicious. Aesthetics are on point.

Name: Arthur C.
Review: This is a perfect place to grab a drink or a quick bite with some friends!  My friend and I came here after a drunken night on the town-- needless to say, we wanted drunk food.  We were planning on the fries, but the waiter recommended the nachos, so we gave him the go ahead.We got chicken nachos which were amazing!  It comes with sides of crème fraîche, guacamole, and mild salsa, all of which were delicious.  The nachos themselves came on a very hot bowl topped with jalapeños, black olives, raw red onions, loads of cheese and interestingly (to us Americans) mayonnaise!  I have to say, the combination was excellent!What makes this place extremely unique is that it's horror movie themed.  When we sat at the table, we noticed a bunch of creepy old dolls hanging from the ceiling to our left.  In addition, they have weird weapons and creepy old family portraits lining the walls.  Very cool spot!

Name: Jeanette J.
Review: I loved Cannibale Royale. The margarita was perfect! The ribs were seasoned well, the BBQ sauces was tangy, a little sweet but not too much and the meat was so tender it literally fell off the bone before I could take a bite. The service was fast and friendly. The atmosphere was chill. I recommend!

Name: Robert A.
Review: Great atmosphere, music, service and food. We got the garlic bread and charcuterie board. Incredible! A must visit if your in Amsterdam.

Name: Rowena P.
Review: Really cool vibe and yummy food in a back alley of the streets of Amsterdam. Definitely recommend for anyone who wants to be right in the scene for a good break before a night out.

Name: Rachel A.
Review: My boyfriend and I stopped here for a late dinner and were very impressed by the food!  The atmosphere was fun and energetic and we were served quickly despite it being busy.  My boyfriend loved the burger and my New York strip was cooked perfectly!

Name: Ang S.
Review: Cannibale Royale feels hidden and away from the flashy tourist traps. It resembles more of a college hangout spot in Lower East Side with the exception of those over-the-top thriller movie props. The food was amazing. Quality meat and awesome burger. What else can you possibly ask for? Definitely get the bitterballen and garlic bread. Creepily addictive.

Name: Carl N.
Review: Absolutely delicious! Probably the best meal I have ever had in Europe. Glad to be a carnivore.

Name: Suzanne F.
Review: Excellent ribs!  Hands down my favorite meal while in amsterdam.  We didn't have reservations so we had a wait.  Not a problem we went and explored and came back to a table. It was well worth the wait.  The ribs were out of this world fall off the bone.  The burger was excellent too!  Great service and fin atmosphere.

Name: Steve M.
Review: This place is off the beaten track and excellent. The burgers are juicy delicious and the pastrami is superb. Atmosphere and service was super good. Well worth the visit.

Name: Kim F.
Review: Amazing!!!! So many choice to pick from... we enjoyed a charcuterie board, dim sum, steak, seafood and fantastic cocktails .....

Name: Sze Ting L.
Review: Fantastic options at foodhallen - I thought it would be an overpriced food hall for mediocre stalls, but we truly found the best! It is extremely diverse and international, but I would recommend the seafood and meatballs stall. I tried the soft shell crab roll, and it was a generous portion of soft shell crab with light batter. The meatballs were mixed with a peanut sauce and came with prawn crackers. The prices were fantastic!

Name: Tim G.
Review: Fun experience, hidden gem.Great food and amazing ambiance. Foodhallen makes for a great night out with friends.

Name: Christy T.
Review: A large space with numerous food options - we ate nachos from Fento then had wontons and dumplings from Dim Sum. Delicious and fun!

Name: Adrian A.
Review: A vibrant lively place. Came here on a Thursday and it was fire! If your from Los Angeles it's very similar to grand central market but way elevated and cleaner!

Name: Jennifer O.
Review: This place was awesome! There were so many food and drink options all under one roof. The worst part was trying to decide what to order. There were several areas to hang out within the food hall that were comfortable. Definitely a must try!

Name: Mehmet A.
Review: Name a country or type of food, and I bet you'll find it in De Foodhallen! I seriously walked around for close to half an hour trying to decide on what to eat, the choices were overwhelming!I settled on a banh mi from the Vietnamese stall, but my friends got the tacos, falafel, and another grabbed something form the burger place. The bathrooms here are also really clean, so you can let it rip without any hesitation!

Name: Annette C.
Review: Super cool place with lots of restaurants and food options! As Amsterdam Photographer I always recommend this place to clients at then end of my Amsterdam Photoshoot + Tour!

Name: David B.
Review: Options for everybody. Great food. Cool place. I just can't seem to leave the taco place alone, though there are so many other options! I try to go with a large group of friends so we can do buffet style and try lots of different things.

Name: Chengru L.
Review: Always a great choice.  Love getting a meal with the family where we don't all have to choose the same type of meal.  Also impressed with the measures taken post COVID.  Ordering via the QR code is convenient and massively cuts down on the close interactions that used to exist here.

Name: Elle F.
Review: my older brother lives in Holland & my family came to visit for the first time. my younger brother & i are very picky & being we're Mexican-American we aren't used to the flavors here & had been having a hard time finding restaurants we all can enjoy. my older brother brought us here as a last resort & we had an amazing time. they have a couple of full bars inside & many different foods from different places. we found something for everyone & met some cool people on the way. definitely recommend!

Name: Teah R.
Review: Loved this place, got indian food (chicken tikka masala) also got the lotus flower bomb at another stall, and the apple pie from kanaria (i think that's how it's spelt)all really good, i 100% want to go back

Name: Alex C.
Review: Amazing place to visit!! They offer a variety of food options with wine and beer . A must do for anyone visiting Amsterdam. I would recommend walking even though it's a little far from central

Name: Shannen C.
Review: Foodhallen was a cool place to grab food and drinks. The place was pretty busy on Wednesday night. Here are some pros and cons of Foodhallen:ProLots of different types of food to choose from.All the foods we tried were tasty and look and tasted fresh. Gin and Tonic bar was amazing, really refreshing and tasty gin and tonic drinks, unlike any Gin and Tonic I had in the States. Awesome vibe! ConHad a hard time finding an open seat after we get our food.A lot of food vendors only take card, no cash option. I guess this is pretty common.Felt like the prices were higher.Overall, fun food and drink experience in Amsterdam and recommend everyone!

Name: Lindsay D.
Review: The concept of food halls is catching-on around the world, and this particular one is definitely a higher caliber than others.I came on a Thursday morning shortly before noon which meant that the shops and food vendors were not open until noon.  This gave me time to walk and browse to spy which vendors were a must go to for me.  The bar was open before noon, so I got myself a Moscow Mule to sip on before chowing down.The bartender was friendly and mixed a very nice drink.  I sat there at the bar as the vendors began to take orders and dole out food.  In the end, I ended up ordering from Bulls and Dogs, Viet View, Jabugo Bar Iberico, and Dim Sum Thing.  Those reviews will all be separate at their respective Yelp pages.The Food Hall was very clean and had plenty of seating for the flow of people that were coming in that afternoon, but I can easily see it getting packed and people spilling out elsewhere to get seats.  The variety in the vendors was a welcomed sight and the prices for almost all vendors was very appropriate.

Name: Gurpreet L.
Review: I am absolutely in love with de Foodhallen and although I left Amsterdam nearly a week ago, I can't stop thinking about this place. The hall itself has a wide array of offerings to fit any hungry visitor's needs. From Vietnamese sandwiches to burrito bowls to cocktail bars, this place really does have it all. It is also very vegan/vegetarian friendly! Not only does it have a lot to offer in terms of food and drinks, but de Foodhallen is also big on sustainability as can be seen with their plates and utensils. Every food stand is unique and it is apparent that each vendor has crafted each dish with care. That combined with their efforts to minimize their environmental impact makes this place a huge win in my book. To be fair, I only tried Fento which does a healthy take on Mexican food and it was one of the best things I've ever had. I tried the vegetarian bowl they had and then the very next day I went back again to have it in burrito form. Both knocked my socks off!

Name: Veronika B.
Review: FoodHallen is an awesome food court with a ton of options. Whatever you eat, they have it! Came here on a Sunday at a very busy time and I was able to get a seat. It's super informal, everybody who helped me was super friendly. I ate the portobello burger from Padron, Dutch vegan cuisine, and it was definitely fantastic! If you need to charge your phone while you eat they have lockers for 1.5euro. Besides the food hall there are a bunch of unique shops and galleries inside and a free bike parking garage underground. Everything is priced reasonably, great atmosphere.

Name: Meredith S.
Review: This was my favorite place to eat in Amsterdam! It seems like they were mostly locals here and not a lot of tourists. It's a giant food hall with a bunch of stalls all around and bars in the center. We went in the evening time and it was absolutely packed but we didn't mind. It was fun to be able to try a bunch of different things. We ended up at the gin and tonic bar which had over a dozen different gin and tonic varieties!

Name: Yvette M.
Review: Nice change of pace. Went there with a group of 6. Everyone was able to get exactly what they were in the mood for. Wide variety of food and drink. Definitely on the docket the next time we are in Amsterdam.

Name: Blake C.
Review: Foodhallen was really cool! It is full of different kinds of food for any and all the cravings you may have. I think I did about 3 laps before even deciding what to get to eat. It was overwhelming with how many choices there were.It was extremely hot in the hall with all the vendors cooking and just the amount of people in the area. It was really crowded and loud but the food was amazing.All I can say is good luck picking a place to eat because it's hard to choose just one!

Name: Sandra H.
Review: Super cool place with lots of restaurants and food options! As Amsterdam Photographer I always recommend this place to clients at then end of my Amsterdam Photoshoot + Tour!

Name: Van B.
Review: [VARIETY] now it is nearly a year ago when we ate at the foodhallen BUT I remember all & we are about to be there again soonish so I will update if necessary!You can order from a big variety of different places offering different dishes. Most of them are "small" portions. As we wanted to share & try as much as possible the portions are great. My partner mostly ordered something vegan|vegetarian for me and something meaty for him.Everything tasted really fresh & special. Quality 100%

Name: LaToya E.
Review: This place is fantastic!! We have a few places like this back home in the states that i enjoy so i was really excited when i came across the reviews online. I cant say much about the neighborhood that its in since we only came over for foodhallen and didnt spend much time walking around outside. I really enjoyed the variety of food vendors, we ordered from maybe 6-8 stalls between the four of us and none of us was dissatisfied with our selections. We also go drinks from the center bar and service was really friendly as it was everywhere we went in the city. I do wish the upstairs was open as seating filled quickly and we had to make multiple rounds of the space and ask someone to share a table before we found a place to sit. Overall i am happy with our choice to eat here and to try as many places as i could.

Name: Alysia W.
Review: If you have a large group or want a lively spot to hangout then De Foodhallen is for you! They have several pop-up restaurants that offer every type of cuisine imaginable plus a large bar in the middle. There is plenty of seating but it gets packed very quickly since it's such a fun environment with live entertainment. When we went it was a young male singer that sounded very similar to John Legend which was great. What I loved about this place is the opportunity to try different types of food all at once. We had Indian food, barbecue, bitterballen, beef cheek stew, fresh smoothies and dessert tartes. Everything was equally delicious and it was nice to try things I've never had before. If there was more time I would have happily returned to check out other options.

Name: John C.
Review: If you can't find a place to eat here, there's something wrong with you.  Everything was amazing.  I had a burger from butcher, tried a pita from Pita.  Had some curry.  All of it was extremely tasty.

Name: Shelby A.
Review: What an awesome experience. Lots of different cuisine to choose from. The sushi spot was UH-MAZING. There were also these balls (I forget the name) with a sauce from a traditional spot and they were delicious, as well. We sat at the middle bar to enjoy our food. The ramen was also on our menu and we weren't disappointed. Would have loved to spend more time here! Bring your appetite!

Name: Shay H.
Review: Loved this restaurant! It's a real gem in Amsterdam. The decor indoors was very sweet and unique- filled with pictures of mothers. Food was delicious as well, and the portions were very generous. It reminded me a lot of home, both in the atmosphere and the comfort food.

Name: Greg T.
Review: This place was amazing! We had the beef stew with onions, green pea soup and the stampot. They were ALL 5-stars with great flavor and love put into each one. The meatball was soft and flavorful and the sausage was also a bit airy, not so dense like others. This place books up fast! (right now they have reservations a month out). If you're a couple of people with no reservations, pop in to see if they had a cancellation. That's how we got it and well worth it!

Name: Jamie B.
Review: My last night in town and I wanted one last traditional Dutch meal. Everyone was very warm and friendly. So glad that I found this place. The place was full and I was unable to get a reservation, but I still took a chance and lucky for me they squeezed me in. Another Yelp winner!

Name: Jennifer S.
Review: I dined at Moeders a few years ago.  It's a very cute restaurant with many photos of mothers on the walls. The menu consists of Dutch dishes and my friend and I enjoyed the authentic Dutch meal. Our server was friendly and we enjoyed our meal. I recommend Moeders!

Name: Serene E.
Review: This is definitely a Dutch experience!  Four of us came on a chilly night out and got an adorable table inside the warm and inviting restaurant. They served us wine while we waited for our table. We ordered two of the Dutch meals for two, which is a little bit of everything Dutch. I mean you leave in a food coma, but it's so worth it. The waiters are so friendly and you feel like you are in your mother's home kitchen.  The place is covered in photos of moms!

Name: Jason V.
Review: Robust, hearty, homestyle Dutch cuisine, served under the watchful gazes of a thousand portraits of beloved mothers of owners, staff and customers alike. The room positively bedazzled with photos, trinkeys and kitschy decor that gives the place the feel of Sunday dinner at Nana's. A truly unique experience in a city full of wonders. Highly recommended.

Name: B S.
Review: There are so many great Dutch restaurants in Amsterdam but Moeders stand out as the best I've had so far. Warm and cozy atmosphere with thousands of pictures of Moeders (Mother's) on the he wall. You definitely should try this great little place. Well worth it!!

Name: Wendy K.
Review: The setting of this restaurant is so cute- none of the dishes match, you're surrounded by pictures and it feels very homey.This is traditional Dutch food and feels as if I'm back at home eating my mom's home cooked dinner. The service here is impeccable.The food, oh my gosh. I couldn't stop eating even after I was uncomfortably full. Do not come to Amsterdam without trying this darling place.

Name: Jackie G.
Review: We made a reservation on their website about a month in advance, but when we arrived there was a sign on the door saying they no longer accept reservations. Odd, but no matter because we were promptly seated outside regardless.Excellent food. We ordered the Stamppot and the Suddervlees. The Stamppot dish was made with mashed potatoes and sauerkraut, gravy, and accompanied by a meatball, bacon, and sausage. Very delicious 5/5. It was a lot to eat and we couldn't finish it all. The Suddervlees was a fantastic beef stew served with potatoes and red cabbage. It was delicious 4.5/5, but unfortunately we did not start putting the potatoes/cabbage into the stew until halfway through. It was even more delicious once we put the potatoes/cabbage in because they soak up the yummy juices.

Name: Herman K.
Review: Freaking amazing, the hostess made the most wonderful suggestion. Camille and the staff were charming and I will say it was like eating at your favorite aunts house.  Awesome food with great portions.  Again, listen to Camille, she will tell you mix it up.  Even the applesauce made this a culinary treat.  Wait til you get to deserts.  Apple pie to die(for).   High ratings!

Name: Leigh P.
Review: The highlight meal for our time in Amsterdam. We ordered the traditional Dutch meal and were very satisfied. The service was quick, warm and attentive. We didn't have reservations but it seemed they reserved a few tables for walk ins. We got there early and had a wonderful small table at the front. Really enjoyed the meal and highly recommend!

Name: Brooke S.
Review: Best place for traditional Dutch food! We got the stew with mashed potatoes and cabbage. Everything was so delicious! The stew was melt in your mouth. I also got the Moeders coffee which came with little cookies on top. Everything was amazing and fun/eclectic atmosphere. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a traditional Dutch meal.

Name: Barbie S.
Review: True Dutch food in a room full of framed photos of mothers (mums, mommies, moms, ma's) from around the world. It was fun just looking around at all the different women who are or were mothers. The food is very seasoned, rich Dutch food. I'm glad we had a reservation because the place was packed.PROS: Stampot            Mother's photos             Miss Pumpkin Salad            Pea and ham soup

Name: Dee K.
Review: I had tried repeatedly to make reservations from the states prior to our arrival with no such luck. Walked in around 6:30 on a Friday night and scored the last empty table. Line formed immediately after us. Service was amazing- friendly and attentive. Loved the ode to mothers everywhere adorning their walls. We each got the rice dish (sampler) for two which included a sampling of all the traditional offerings. It was delicious!!

Name: Gary L.
Review: Great local hangout. Very "Amsterdam"!  The food is authentic as is the interior decor.  This place has a story to tell and you won't forget the experience.

Name: Tim J.
Review: Molders is Dutch for Mothers. People were encouraged over the years to bring in pictures of the years of their moms. You see all over pics of peoples moms. Pictures give it that home-like feel. The food here was awesome. I recommend trying everything. And leave room for dessert. You won't be disappointed.

Name: Franco C.
Review: Small. Quaint restaurant.  Very busy. No reservations.  Worth the wait. Great onion soup. Heat stew with red cabbage, potatoes both roasted and bolied a chunky apple sauce to go with the bacon and sausage. Excellent meal. Also ribs are on the menu.

Name: Bethany W.
Review: Want to try true Dutch food?  Then this is the place to be!  Moders means Mothers in Dutch, and there are pictures all over the walls of Moms from all over the globe.  You can send them a picture of a Mom, and they will try to put it somewhere.I had the Hotchpotch which was mashed potatoes (and the waitress recommended it with sauerkraut, yup, good!), sausage, bacon and a delicious meatball.   He had the Suddervlees, which was braised beef, potatoes and red cabbage.  We shared both dishes and thoroughly enjoyed them!  Comfort Food!!!Beyond the food, it's a true, local Dutch establishment.  You really have to try traditional Dutch cuisine while in the Netherlands.  In Amsterdam, this place is a gem.  We were lucky to have been able to be seated without any reservations.  However, it was packed, so reservations are definitely recommended.

Name: Shelby W.
Review: My boyfriend and I wanted to try some Dutch food and get a real feel for Amsterdam. We took the Metro to have dinner here and it was packed both inside and on the patio! The wait time for 2 people would have been an hour. No worries.. We'll try again tomorrow night and now we know to make a reservation.We went back the next night and got the spinach potatoes with sausage and bacon. It came with a delicious and large salad as well as a dessert for 15 euros. The food was amazing! The plates of food may not look that large, but those potatoes sure do full you up! We weren't able to finish all of ours.The service was friendly, great prices, and good beer on tap. Definitely recommend! Best dinner I ate during my 5 days in Amsterdam! ****Don't forget to make your reservation!!!!!*****

Name: Athena C.
Review: See why the hype is all about, this is a down to earth authentic feel to the restaurant. Food tasted straight from Mama's kitchen.

Name: Benjamin H.
Review: Yum. Good Dutch food. We got the mix of everything for two people. They are very accommodating with seating. If you don't have a reservation, you can wait outside by the canal and have drinks til your table is ready. Just a short walk to Jordaan. It was perfect for my last dinner in Amsterdam.

Name: Vicki L.
Review: This was an EXCELLENT dining experience! The food, wine and service were all insanely representative of the cultural melting pot that is Amsterdam.  Our service staff was attentive, fun and made the experience even more enjoyable. We had a server, very nice and friendly young lady originally from Iran, even we exchanged with emails. After our meal she brought a bottle of something similar to German  "Jagermeister",but it was a much better.Looking forward to visiting again on our next trip to Holland!

Name: Zaid N.
Review: Authentic Indonesian cuisine and really nice rice tables for dinner. Made a reservation for a Tuesday evening for two and when we got there, we were seated right away. Took a little time to get our orders but we placed whatever was on the second page and it was epic. Great experience, good food throughout and delicious tastes. I would recommend this spot for a group or a date - both are fun outings - enjoy!

Name: Katherine D.
Review: This is one of the best meals I've ever had. It was a thrill to try Indonesian food for the first time. We had the skewer samplers and enjoyed the lamb and beef the most. They were full of flavor. The chicken was also good, but we preferred the other meats more. We also ordered the sampler platter with noodles instead of rice. It was delicious. Some parts were spicy, some had more earthy flavors, but even the cucumbers were great. They also had a good wine selection. Next time, we will try the tasting menu!

Name: Maria P.
Review: We wanted to try Indonesian cuisine while we were in Amsterdam since we've heard some pretty great things about it.  Sampurna was a convenient walk away from our hotel and they were open pretty late while everything seemed to be closed or was closing.  It's easy to find as they are located right next to the Bloemenmarkt (floating flower market).  We walked into the restaurant and were greeted & seated right away.  The restaurant was pretty empty and we had the section all to ourself, perfect!It was my first time trying Indonesian food and I was quite amused that a lot of the menu items were familiar terms used in Filipino languages.  Now, I told my husband that I wasn't that hungry, but somehow he managed to order the Rijtafel which is a whole spread of food that took up the entire table.  I definitely gave him "the look" but hey we were on our honeymoon and the food came out rather quickly.  Not to mention the prices were affordable for the amount of food that we got (A LOT), even in such a touristy area.  Everything was laid out so nicely and perfectly organized in several small, shared plates.  We had a sampling of a number of dishes and our meal came with little sauces/spices which I wanted to try out first. The first thing that I tried was out of this world spicy (It smelled similar to something used in Filipino cuisine & I am not a big fan of spicy food).  I wanted to cry, but my husband had a good laugh!  It's hilarious now that I can look back on it, but it wasn't at the time.  I learned after that to stick to the more milder flavored dishes which were oh so tasty.  Overall, good meal & I would recommend it if you're looking to try Indonesian cuisine and want to have the rice table experience (Rijtafel).  Just be prepared for the spiciness.  I was not, Lol.

Name: Meetu M.
Review: Very good food and introduction to Indonesian food.  Highly recommend this restaurant. Overall great dining experience!

Name: Zaid N.
Review: Authentic Indonesian cuisine and really nice rice tables for dinner. Made a reservation for a Tuesday evening for two and when we got there, we were seated right away. Took a little time to get our orders but we placed whatever was on the second page and it was epic. Great experience, good food throughout and delicious tastes. I would recommend this spot for a group or a date - both are fun outings - enjoy!

Review: This is one of the best meals I've ever had. It was a thrill to try Indonesian food for the first time. We had the skewer samplers and enjoyed the lamb and beef the most. They were full of flavor. The chicken was also good, but we preferred the other meats more. We also ordered the sampler platter with noodles instead of rice. It was delicious. Name: Meetu M.
Review: Very good food and introduction to Indonesian food.  Highly recommend this restaurant. Overall great dining experience!

Name: Lei G.
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed my lunch at Sampurna! It's located near the floating flower market but doesn't come across as stop for tourists. I'd been trying to get in more Indonesian meals while in Amsterdam. I do not know the names of any of my dishes, other than my ginger honey tea. The taste of the food was even better than the photos. The starter was tasty & delicate. The entree had two different types of veggies and the chicken was full of spices and the rice was done perfectly. The dessert was the cherry on top - it was coconut milk, green tapioca, much softer than typical tapioca with fresh sliced jackfruit. It'll be a dessert I'll be on the lookout for in the future!

Name: Sabrina S.
Review: This was my first time having a full Indonesian meal and it did not disappoint.  I really liked the appetizers that were included.  Food was fresh, delicious, and boldly flavored.  We were able to get in without a reservation without any issue, which I appreciated considering how packed the place was when we arrived.  I cannot really think of anything I didn't like, so 5 stars it is!

Name: Akriti M.
Review: While going through the recommendations for Indonesian cuisine, we came across this highly rated place and thought of giving it a try. Ordering the rice table was our obvious choice after seeking suggestions from the server and also since we could see it on each table! Its hard to describe in words the happiness you feel when they bring that huge and meticulously well laid out platter to your table ( only a true food lover can relate to the butterflies I had in my tummy that time ;)). Each and every item was delicious and the spices were perfect to our taste.The location, ambience, service and specially the food makes this a go-to place if anyone is in mood for engaging themselves in a gastronomical experience.The only flipside that comes to my mind is the price. Only if it was a bit lighter on our pocket, it would have been a true value for money!

Name: Matthew L.
Review: Our group of 7 made it out here and ordered a few of the pre-fix menu items, which all seemed to be based on level of spiciness and what it contained (chicken, beef, seafood). We ordered 7 portions and this was more than enough food. There must have been about 12-14 small dishes per order and the courses ranged from 29 - 35 euros.This all came with rice, and the Items included beef skewers, pork skewers, cod in a spicy chile sauce, vegetable curry soup, beef stew, pork flakes, roasted walnuts w/ bacon, tofu curry, and a bunch of other items that I can't even recall. The food was pretty spicy and really flavorful, bordering on too much flavor and salt. You'll definitely need to cut it down by eating it with plenty of rice, I don't think I could have had too much of any item without mixing it with the rice.It's a really beautiful restaurant, and I would be all about taking a date here. Service was also efficient, because jeez, the number of plates was bonkers! There were some issues initially with the waiter saying they didn't allow more than 2 of the pre-fix courses to be ordered per group/table, which we all found odd. The manager than came over and overruled the waiter o_O.

Name: Mimi N.
Review: While reminiscing over my Europe trip pictures, stumbled across some delicious food pictures and I knew I had to help spread the word on this awesome place. Located near the Flower Market, this cute little restaurant serves one of the besttttt Indonesian food I have ever had (in comparison to the places in the States).Once you enter, the atmosphere is quite nice. From the soft candle lights to the dimly lit interior, this place is ideal for dates or small group get together for its intimate feel. With an upscale fanciness, do expect prices per person to be at least $30+ (USD) if you plan on doing the set courses.For my group of 4, we ordered 2 different sets that came with a variety of dishes. In total, we must have received around 24 tapa like style dishes and man......FOOD COMA ALLLLLL DAY.Each dish was stellar. From the execution of the various meats (lamb/beef/chicken/pork/goat) to the combination of veggies + spices....all the dishes were spot on and I couldn't find one dish that I didn't like.Service is pretty decent. If your table seems to be water guzzlers, simply ask for a pitcher since the waiters don't swing by too often. With drinks included, it came to be around $40/person (USD)......A bit pricey for dinner but super worth it for the experience of "rice tables" when visiting Amsterdam.

Name: Manny D.
Review: Our first dinner in Amsterdam (late November 2019), was recommended by the check in person of our Hotel (NH Collection - Flower Market) and was truly amazed by the food! Be sure to make a reservation though.

Name: Matt L.
Review: Indonesian food is so tasty and flavorful and this is authentic. Spend the money for a tasting menu for two, priced between 27 and 30 Euros per person. It's a lot of food but not too much and the selections are great. We made reservations through Open Table and still had to wait 30 minutes. The place was packed on a Saturday night at 7:30. A host/waiter saw my down turned face as we waited in the cramped space and brought over shrimp crackers and gave me a free beer. That's service. The amount of food coming from the kitchen is amazing. Watching the staff as we waited was like seeing the ballet on stage. By the time we got to our table we knew what we wanted, put in our order and it started arriving about 10 minutes later. Spicy and marinated chicken dishes, beef satay and a beef stew, vegetable dishes in coconut sauce, tofu dish in spicy peanut sauce. Really tasty, would go again.

Name: Travis C.
Review: A fantastic Indonesian restaurant in downtown Amsterdam. I had visited Indonesia a couple weeks before coming here, and I was pleasantly surprised to find that the cuisine had not been overtly changed to appeal to Western tastes. We got one of the rice tables, which provided a great overview of Indonesian cuisine for my dinning companion who had not been there. The strongest dishes were the shrimp, the tempeh and the chicken in coconut sauce. The skewers left a bit to be desired. They also have Bintang beer, which is the iconic beer of Indonesia. Well priced and good service. Reservations recommended.

Name: Joe M.
Review: Great food - really tasty and the platter size was perfect. In a really really good location, it's impressive that it wasn't really that crowded. Was a perfect cozy relief from a busy day.

Name: Raquel B.
Review: This was my first time having Indonesian food! Loved it. They didn't have a completely vegan option so we ordered Vegetarian. Flavors were delightful.

Name: courtney o.
Review: I have been to Amsterdam three times and every time I visit I make it a point to eat here. The food is amazing. We have tried so many things on the menu and they are all fabulous. The rice table is enough for two people and very delicious. This restaurant is one of the best Indonesian cuisine I have ever had. Can't wait to return.

Name: Steve F.
Review: Quant little Indonesian restaurant near the flower market.  Great location near from almost anywhere in the city center. We had tried Rijsttafel at another place, and wanted to try it again. This was just as good.  The atmosphere is subdued and the tables all have candles.  They place the veggie crisps on each table so that you have something to munch on when you arrive.  Beat to make a reservation as we saw many people turned away throughout our meal, and this was on a Wednesday night. We each had a glass of the house wine, mine was from Spain, my wife's from Italy.  Both pretty good. We got the Celebe rijstafell, and they price it as per person with a minimum of 2.  The food was good, tasty, and more than enough to fill us up.  One item was way too spicy for me.  Service is pleasant, but sometimes it took a while for hen to check back with us.  A little more frequency with walking by would have been nice to refresh our drinks.  They were really busy, and could probably use another waiter.  But they were all very nice.  The small room can get noisy, but that seems typical of the small size restaurants in Amsterdam.  We would go back.

Name: Nisha T.
Review: Right next to the flower market. This place is amazing. Best Indonesian food I have had. The variety of tastes you experience is worth the price. You have to get one of the Rice tables, which is an assortment of curries, meat, veggies, etc.

Name: Nancy L.
Review: Excellent food.  Ordered rice table and the fish dish.  Very authentic.  I eat Indonesian food all the time.Only complaint is they want to charge me the price of another hot tea 3 euros to get more hot water.  Never heard of this before.  I'm a world traveler, and this was the first.  I can't blame the server but I'm writing in the hope the owner is reading this review.

Name: G T.
Review: Tasty food and lovely restaurant. The service was excellent. Highly recommend the rice table for small portions of several dishes to get some Indo tasting

Name: Cindy C.
Review: Our server was great!! Food was delicious. Very tiny restaurant in amsterdam super cozy. The 3 course special was good!

Name: Jack C.
Review: Dear Craig,What a gem! If you're looking for an authentic meal from Amsterdam this is the place to go.  You better be hungry too because the portions are large.We started with soup.  The Tomato soup was great, not creamy which is the way I like it.  After trying the split Pea soup, there is no question.  You've got to get the split pea soup.  Flavors were string and delicious.
